steps.tx: The **five prime cap** (seven methylguanosine linked five to five triphosphate, added when nascent RNA reaches about twenty five nucleotides by capping enzyme recruited to serine five phosphorylated tail, methylations on first nucleotides following) protects from five prime exonucleases, licenses export and recruits cap binding complex for pioneer translation and nonsense surveillance. Viruses steal caps (influenza cap snatching endonuclease baloxavir target) or encode own capping (coronavirus proofreading plus cap methylation immune evasion), applied enzymology examinations now include.
steps.say: The five prime cap protects, licenses export and recruits pioneer translation machinery co-transcriptionally. Influenza steals caps by endonuclease snatching targeted by baloxavir antivirally in clinics and examinations.

steps.tx: **Polyadenylation**: cleavage and polyadenylation specificity factor reads AAUAAA ten to thirty bases upstream of cleavage, poly-A polymerase adds about two hundred adenines template independently, poly-A binding protein coats and circularises mRNA with initiation factors (closed loop enhancing reinitiation), deadenylation (CCR4-NOT) rate limits most decay pathways cytoplasmically. Alternative polyadenylation sites shorten three prime UTRs in proliferating and cancer cells (miRNA sites shed), histone mRNAs uniquely end in stem loops without tails (replication dependent S phase coupled decay).
steps.say: Polyadenylation adds about two hundred adenines template independently circularising messages for reinitiation efficiently. Alternative sites shorten regulatory tails in proliferating and cancer cells proliferatively and pathologically.

steps.tx: **Alternative splicing** (exon skipping commonest vertebrate, mutually exclusive exons, alternative five/three prime sites and intron retention) multiplies one gene into tissue proteomes (tropomyosin, CD44, Bcl-x apoptotic long anti versus short pro, FGFR2 epithelial/mesenchymal epithelial splicing regulatory proteins ESRP, neuronal Rbfox, muscle MBNL sequestered by myotonic dystrophy CTG expansions in trans (spliceopathy: chloride channel ClC-1 retained introns causing myotonia, insulin receptor isoform metabolic disease) proving splicing regulation diseases beyond cis mutations in single genes (beta thalassaemia splice donors, spinal muscular atrophy SMN2 exon seven skipping).
steps.say: Alternative splicing multiplies genes into tissue proteomes regulatorially, while myotonic expansions sequester splicing factors in trans spliceopathy. SMN2 exon skipping therapy anchors the next step clinically and examinably.

steps.tx: **Nusinersen** (antisense oligonucleotide blocking intronic splicing silencer ISS-N1 in SMN2 intron seven) forces exon seven inclusion producing full length SMN protein, transforming spinal muscular atrophy survival intrathecally dosed, while risdiplam (oral small molecule splicing modifier) and onasemnogene gene replacement triangulate one exon by three modalities, the finest applied splicing lesson in current medicine. Splice switching for Duchenne exon skipping (eteplirsen exon fifty one, reading frame restoration Becker like protein) extends the principle with modest dystrophin gains debated.
steps.say: Nusinersen forces SMN2 exon seven inclusion transforming spinal muscular atrophy survival intrathecally. Risdiplam and gene replacement triangulate one exon by three modalities in current applied splicing medicine.
